investigation_notes: Network security investigation of a monitored LAN. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over Zeek and Suricata logs (IDS alerts, Kerberos, HTTP downloads, TLS certificates, domains and external-destination activity). No root cause, impact or C2 attribution is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Network context: LAN segment range: 10.10.22.0/24 (10.10.22.0 through 10.10.22.255); Domain: enemywatch.net; Domain Controller: 10.10.22.22 - ENEMYWATCH-DC; LAN segment gateway: 10.10.22.1; LAN segment broadcast address: 10.10.22.255.
